stack: Kotlin / Jetpack Compose / Material 3 (androidx.navigation, in-memory repository)

bad_guidance.why: Core pick tells you to remove card containers. The project's whole surface system is NbCard (OutlinedCard, 12dp, 1dp outline) and the freeze row lives inside one; 'card' in the sentence is a payment card, not a UI container. Following it would have deleted the settings group.
Correct mobile focus advice, but the screen already satisfies it (Material3 Switch + NbListRow). Says nothing about the instant, unconfirmed, unannounced state change the sentence is about.
Selected as a critical concept carrier for table.tabular_figures; the task touches no numerals and the project already has a full type scale in Type.kt.
Table-to-list-row conversion, filter sheets and bulk selection. There is no table on the cards screen.

Both pre-registered critical concepts (feedback.confirmation_destructive, state.saving_conflict) are absent. confirmation_destructive was demanded only as recommended and then dropped; carriers exist in the base (comp-dialog, states-persistence-and-session, feedback-progress-async).

guidance_ignored.why: Contradicts the project's NbCard surface system and misreads 'card' as a UI container.
No table, no filters, no bulk selection on this screen.
No numeric or type-scale work in this change; Type.kt already defines the roles.
Already satisfied by the existing Material3 controls; adds nothing to the task.

misses.what: mode=create on an existing-UI defect report ('mode evidence: create: default (no cue at all)'). The screen exists; expected refactor/polish. This is the root of the whole off-target bundle.

intent.artifact_state=unknown, existing=false, problem=false; problem_domain=['performance-ux'] inferred from the stem 'freez' (freeze = jank), which is the opposite of the real domain; primary_jobs=['create card'] and components=['card'] from the payment-card noun.
cards slot set to card-none / status 'new' on a moderate-budget existing UI whose surfaces slot was correctly preserved as bordered-flat. The two are inconsistent with each other.

navigation detected as 'top-bar' although the shell is NorthBankBottomBar (4 bottom tabs) with a per-screen TopAppBar; spacing UNKNOWN although Spacing.kt is an explicit 4-pt object used by every screen; radius 'small' (4dp, from the 2 chip corners) although CardCornerRadius=12dp is the documented surface radius.

regressions.query: Freezing a card happens the instant you touch the switch.
regressions.expect: mode refactor/polish (not create); feedback.confirmation_destructive and state.saving_conflict in the bundle as critical; no card-container pattern in the cards slot.

regressions.query: The delete toggle applies immediately with no confirmation.
regressions.expect: feedback.confirmation_destructive carried by a DIRECT record; undo/reversibility mentioned.
